{{Top|leg}}
The '''cockpit shield''' was a part on the [[StarSpeeder 3000]] line of [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The cockpit shield was an opaque piece of material that separated the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] from the passenger area of the craft. So divided, the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] had to use a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] to address passengers. However, the shield could be lowered to allow direct interaction.
